changeSet.sql:
set identity_insert [security].[Rule] on; insert into [security].[Rule] (ID, Uid, Name, RoleID, SecurityType, AssetTypeId, ApplyToType, IsVisible, IsOverride, CreatedBy, CreatedOn, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn) select r.ID, r.Uid, r.Name, r.ResponsibilityTypeID, 2 as SecurityType, a.ID as AssetTypeId, r.ApplyToType, r.IsVisible, 0 as IsOverride, r.CreatedBy, r.CreatedOn, r.UpdatedBy, r.UpdatedOn from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r left join AssetType a on a.Object = r.Object and a.ObjectID = r.ObjectID set identity_insert [security].[Rule] off;
-- Set the security type ( [G]roup OR [U]ser ) update t set t.SecurityType = s.SecurityType from [security].[Rule] t inner join ( select r.ID, iif(sec.[Object] = 'GroupType', 1, 2) as SecurityType from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r cross apply openjson(r.Definition) with ( [Then] nvarchar(max) as json ) d cross apply openjson(d.[Then]) with ( Object varchar(50) ) sec ) s on s.ID = t.Id;

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: insert into [security].RuleThen select r.ID, row_number() over(partition by r.Id order by r.Id) as [Position], iif(ti.FieldTypeID = 0 and ti.FieldTypeName = 'Name', 1, ti.[Operator]) as Operator, iif(ti.FieldTypeID > 0, ti.FieldTypeID, null) as FieldTypeId, iif(ti.FieldTypeID > 0, ti.[Value], null) as [Value], iif(ti.FieldTypeID = 0 and ti.FieldTypeName = 'Name', ti.[Value], null) as SecurityId from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r cross apply openjson(r.Definition) with ( [Then] nvarchar(max) as json ) d cross apply openjson(d.[Then]) with ( --Object varchar(50), --ObjectID int, Conditions nvarchar(max) as json ) t cross apply openjson(t.[Conditions]) with ( [Operator] varchar(25), [FieldTypeID] int, FieldTypeName nvarchar(250), [Value] nvarchar(500)--, --IntersectTypeID int, --TargetObject varchar(50), --TargetObjectID int ) ti;

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: insert into [security].RuleWhen select r.Id, row_number() over(partition by r.Id order by r.Id) as [Position], wi.CheckType, iif(wi.FieldTypeID > 0, wi.FieldTypeId, null) as FieldTypeId, iif(wi.IntersectTypeID > 0, wi.IntersectTypeID, null) as IntersectTypeId, --wi.*, iif(wi.IntersectTypeID > 0, 1, coalesce(wi.[Operator], 1)) as [Operator], iif(wi.FieldTypeID > 0, wi.[Value], null) as [Value], a.Id as AssetId from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r cross apply openjson(r.Definition) with ( [When] nvarchar(max) as json ) w cross apply openjson(w.[When]) with ( [CheckType] char(1), [Operator] varchar(25), [FieldTypeID] int, FieldTypeName nvarchar(250), [Value] nvarchar(500), IntersectTypeID int, TargetObject varchar(50), TargetObjectID int ) wi left join Asset a on a.Object = wi.TargetObject and a.ObjectID = wi.TargetObjectID;
